# Ultralytics YOLO11-m (Pre-Optimized)

Object Detection · `yolo11-m_640x640_pre-optimized` · DX-APP Python example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** AGPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolo11_m_640x640_pre_optimized
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/yolo11/yolo11-m_640x640_pre-optimized/yolo11-m_640x640_pre-optimized_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolo11-m_640x640_pre-optimized.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolo11-m_640x640_pre-optimized_sync   # once
./bin/yolo11-m_640x640_pre-optimized_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolo11-m_640x640_pre-optimized.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 50.60 |
| Q-Lite | 49.90 (−0.70) |
